context.recovered_rationale: This matters because new NIH grants dropped to approximately 2300, roughly half the prior year's level, even after Congress restored the budget in a bipartisan spending bill. existing.description_medium: In March 2025, the Trump administration invoked the 1798 Alien Enemies Act to deport hundreds of Venezuelan migrants, designating the Tren de Aragua gang a foreign enemy. Federal judges in multiple districts issued emergency orders halting the deportations. The administration flew planes to El Salvador anyway, with officials racing to complete flights before judges could enforce orders. Chief Justice Roberts took the unusual step of issuing a temporary hold. Trump officials publicly mocked the rulings, marking an unprecedented defiance of federal courts.
